candidate: Luo et al. 2022 Tvärminne Daphnia rock-pool metacommunity
scientific_target: survey-recorded annual recolonisation of Daphnia magna rock-pool occupancy, conditioned on realised occupied source pools in the preceding year

node_universe.definition: 546 clearly delimited rock pools in the Tvärminne archipelago monitored as habitat patches independently of focal-year Daphnia occupancy
node_universe.sampling_schedule: two samples per year, spring and midsummer
node_universe.annual_occupancy_rule: occupied in year t if observed in at least one of the two samples

response_semantics: The eventual endpoint is annual survey-recorded occupancy transition 0->1. Missing observations must remain distinguishable from recorded absence; the published modelling choice to treat a small fraction of post-2008 missing values as zero is not imported automatically into EOG.

prospective_estimability.reason: The published paper establishes a long repeated patch-occupancy series but does not provide endpoint-matched annual D. magna 0->1 and 0->0 count lower bounds for a frozen calibration/heldout split without opening response rows. Older published colonisation totals use a different colonisation definition and are not substituted.
prospective_estimability.execution_policy: continue response-blind only; exact count gate required before any model fit or heldout score

candidate_external_comparators: authors' Bayesian spatially explicit stochastic patch-occupancy/metacommunity model
a frozen area-plus-source-connectivity colonisation baseline derived from the same response-independent patch registry
a strong non-EOG supervised baseline using the same frozen covariates and temporal split

allowed_gate0: file names, IDs, sizes, checksums and anonymous download URLs
ZIP end-of-central-directory and central-directory metadata only
forbidden_gate0: fitted colonisation/extinction parameters used to tune EOG worlds

gate0_pass_requires: stable anonymous Figshare metadata for article 20329245 version 1
exact top-level file identities and checksums frozen
archive member directory inspectable without downloading member contents
complete 546-pool response-independent registry/geometry or pairwise distance representation identifiable in member(s) distinct from occupancy response member(s)
process_source_boundary: Prediction is conditional on realised occupied pools within the declared 546-pool Tvärminne patch system at the preceding year. No unique dispersal history, ancestry, or external-source closure is assumed without separate evidence.
no_rescue: do not open occupancy rows merely to locate geometry
do not treat published fitted dispersal or interaction parameters as EOG world scales after outcome access
do not recode post-2008 missing observations as biological absences before the response contract is frozen
do not change the temporal split after response access
do not lower exact count minima
do not add candidate-specific connectivity operators
do not use archive-member co-location as permission to read response rows
